input: Search the web for kids' "summer program" offerings (programs that don't call themselves camps) for kids and teens in Madison, Yancey, Mitchell and McDowell counties, NC (Marshall, Mars Hill, Burnsville, Marion). Use that wording in your searches, not just "camp", and list every organization you find.

candidates.name: Madison County Parks and Recreation
candidates.note: Summer recreation program with organized trips; official page includes 2025 reservations and a 2026 trip schedule.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Madison County 4-H
candidates.note: 2025 Summer Fun educational programs for ages 5–18, including agriculture, science, cooking and outdoor activities.

candidates.name: Mars Hill University
candidates.note: Invite-only Summer Launch, August 4–22, 2025, for incoming first-year students; includes housing, a college course and supervised trips.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Yancey County 4-H
candidates.note: 2025 Summer Fun youth learning programs; summer activities also included nutrition and pollinator projects.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Mitchell County 4-H
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Fun sessions for ages 5–18 include food preservation, photography, electricity, robotics, crafts and shooting skills.

candidates.name: Partners Aligned Toward Health
candidates.note: Appalachian Youth to Youth Summer Experience ran in Spruce Pine in August 2025, with youth empowerment and leadership activities.
